title: Probing AI Safety with Source Code
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety of Large Language Models (LLMs) by probing for toxic outputs (such as profanity and insults) using a code-based prompting technique. While toxicity and safety are ethical concerns in AI development, the research is a technical vulnerability assessment targeting content moderation filters rather than a study benchmarking religious knowledge, spiritual traditions, or complex moral/theological reasoning.
